publicSourceReview.flaggedExamples: Synthetic launcher self-test paths and resource/dependency strings were manually reviewed.
publicSourceReview.scope: Reviewed public source and portable editable copies; local profiles, sessions, credentials and rollback snapshots are excluded.

method: Production tests used private application data and synthetic native lifecycle records. The final packaged executable was started with a private profile, synthetic Codex home, log-only quota and startup registration disabled. The installed desktop pet and real account data were not changed.
limits: Pattern scanning cannot prove that every possible secret is absent. Frame-rate and visual measurements describe the tested environment. Known event-interface limitations are documented in the release notes.
